dog.description_text:
August is a real beauty! This 5-month old, 5.5 pound (as of 11/20) pure black kitten is sweet, sleek, smart, and totally obsessed with Churu treats!

Fully litter-box trained, August is a champ in the bathroom department. He eats well, he snacks even better, and he is a marvelous self-groomer, so he always looks neat and clean. His soft plush coat is utterly magnificent and his alluring light-colored eyes are captivating. And he knows it!

August gets along well with other cats…especially when he’s got another kitty to play with and then his silly side can come out. He’s initially shy around humans, but he’s becoming braver by the day. If you sit next to him on the couch, he is happy being close to you and loves it when you pet him. You can tell he wants to let his guard down, and he’s definitely getting there.

August is a super nice ‘lil guy who is ready to find his forever home and spend his life with people who will show him the way and love him for the gentle soul that he is. And for that, he will give you the world.

If you would like to adopt August, comment ADOPT and we’ll send you an application.
